records.name: IIT Kanpur - E&ICT Academy
records.description: IIT Kanpur's Electronics and ICT Academy (E&ICT Academy) is a Ministry of Electronics and IT funded initiative for capacity building in electronics, ICT, and emerging technologies, offering short-term training, certification, and faculty development programs. It conducts programs for working professionals, industry employees, and government officials on topics including AI/ML, IoT, embedded systems, and cybersecurity. The E&ICT Academy leverages IIT Kanpur's technical expertise to bridge the skills gap in India's electronics and technology sectors.

records.name: IIT Guwahati - Centre for Drone Technology
records.description: IIT Guwahati's Centre for Drone Technology is a specialized research and training hub focused on UAV design, development, and operations, developing indigenous drone technologies for defense, agriculture, and disaster management applications. The centre offers short-term certificate programs and postgraduate research projects in drone engineering, autonomous systems, and aerial imaging. IIT Guwahati's northeast location makes the centre particularly relevant for border surveillance, forest monitoring, and disaster response drone applications.

records.name: IITRAM Ahmedabad
records.description: Institute of Infrastructure, Technology, Research and Management (IITRAM) in Ahmedabad is a government engineering institute established by the Government of Gujarat, offering B.Tech. and M.Tech. programs in civil, electrical, mechanical, and interdisciplinary engineering. It is known for its focus on infrastructure engineering and smart city technologies, aligning with Gujarat's development priorities. IITRAM has growing research programs in water management, structural engineering, and sustainable infrastructure.

records.name: Vel Tech Chennai
records.description: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology in Chennai is a private deemed university offering engineering, technology, and science programs with a strong emphasis on applied research and industry collaboration. It is known for its aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, and computer science programs. Vel Tech has research collaborations with DRDO, ISRO, and NASA and offers innovative interdisciplinary programs in drone technology and robotics.

records.name: Indian Institute of Drone Technology (IIDT)
records.description: Indian Institute of Drone Technology (IIDT) in Sehore, Madhya Pradesh is a specialized institution offering training and certification programs in drone operations, drone repair and maintenance, and drone entrepreneurship. As an RPTO (Remote Pilot Training Organisation) approved by DGCA, IIDT trains commercial drone pilots for agriculture, surveying, and logistics applications. The institute plays a role in developing drone technology skills in Central India, aligned with India's national drone policy goals.

records.name: Presidency University
records.description: Presidency University in Bangalore is a private university offering programs in engineering, management, and science with strong emphasis on technology and entrepreneurship. It has state-of-the-art infrastructure including research labs, innovation centers, and industry-integrated training programs. Presidency University benefits from its Bengaluru location for tech industry placements and internships with leading IT companies.

records.name: IIT Madras - CBEEV
records.description: IIT Madras's Centre for Battery Engineering and Electric Vehicles (CBEEV) is a specialized research center driving India's transition to electric mobility, working on battery chemistry, BMS (Battery Management Systems), motor drives, and EV powertrain integration. The centre collaborates with leading automotive OEMs, battery manufacturers, and DST for developing indigenous EV technology solutions. CBEEV offers Ph.D. programs and postdoctoral research in EV and energy storage technology and represents India's flagship academic institution for electric mobility research.

records.name: IIT Delhi - CART
records.description: IIT Delhi's Centre for Automotive Research and Tribology (CART) is a research center dedicated to automotive engineering, engine technology, tribology, and advanced vehicle systems including EVs and fuel cells. It offers Ph.D. programs and conducts industry-sponsored research for automotive companies including Maruti Suzuki, Hero MotoCorp, and international OEMs. CART is a bridge between academia and India's automotive manufacturing sector, developing next-generation automotive technologies.

records.name: NIT Calicut
records.description: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) in Kozhikode is one of India's premier NITs, established in 1961, consistently ranked among the top 10 NITs nationally. It offers B.Tech., M.Tech., MBA, MCA, and Ph.D. programs across engineering, sciences, and management, and is particularly known for its architecture and electrical engineering programs. NIT Calicut's alumni have strong representation in Gulf-based engineering companies, Indian IT firms, and academia.

records.name: Delhi Technological University
records.description: Delhi Technological University (DTU), formerly Delhi College of Engineering, is one of India's largest and most reputed state technical universities, established in 1941, offering B.Tech., M.Tech., MBA, and Ph.D. programs. It is consistently ranked among the top 15 engineering institutions in India and is particularly known for its electronics, computer science, and mechanical engineering programs. DTU's location in the national capital provides exceptional industry access, and its graduates are well placed in IT, consulting, PSUs, and startups.
